correctness.rationale: The normalized spherical addition kernel yields exact 24×24 rational matrices. A parity/Walsh decomposition of the 24-cell adjacency gives joint spectrum 8[1],0[9],-4[2] in even parity and 4[4],-2[8] in odd parity, hence the four sample eigenlevels with full rank. Explicit flat eigenvectors for the endpoint eigenvalues produce the Rayleigh lower bound 5 for squared condition number for every positive weight, and the equality eigenvector equation forces uniform weights. A standalone exact-rational checker independently confirms first five ranks, kernel polynomial, trace identities, Gram inverse and both endpoint eigenvectors.

value.rationale: The 24-cell is a natural 24-point 5-design and quaternionic unit configuration, but its design strength is insufficient to predict fourth-band degree-eight products. At the first band permitting arbitrary interpolation, exact singular levels and global uniquely optimal weighting determine sharp stability and give an explicit optimal interpolation formula. The nonflat four-level spectrum and uniqueness under every positive diagonal reweighting are concrete natural frame invariants rather than an arbitrary slice.
